svg.text: W07 Find a vehicle (Rider) / Live map (Ops manager)
Assignment screen 5: Workflow 3. $geoNear within 5 km of a selectable origin, refreshed by polling.
RideSync · Team 20 · low-fidelity wireframe
localhost/map?origin=union-square

g.text: Sorted by distance · one row per vehicle
Shows at most the nearest 20 vehicles.

svg.text: ANNOTATIONS
Origin
Preset chips, or click anywhere on the map.
The radius is fixed at 5 km (Workflow 3); the
circle is drawn to scale and markers are
numbered by distance.
Live without reload
Polls GET /api/map/nearby-vehicles every 5 s,
and only the markers and list update. Polling
pauses while the tab is hidden or Pause is on.
One marker per vehicle
The server groups pings by vehicle_id and
keeps the nearest, so a vehicle never appears
twice.
What changed
A vehicle that is new since the last poll gets
a NEW tag for one cycle. Vehicles that left
the radius fade out.
Book
Opens Book a trip with this vehicle already
selected (rider journey: find → book). Ops
mode shows 'Details' instead.
Simulate pings
Inserts fresh pings near the origin so the
live update is visible. Seeded pings expire
after 2 h because of the TTL index.
List = accessible view
The list carries the same information as the
map, sorted by distance and reachable by
keyboard.
